# ThirdPerson

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

With DesktopView: the camera behind and above the eyes.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `distance` | `float` | m back along the view (4) |
| `height` | `float` | part of the distance above the eyes (0.25) |

## Notes

Added by PlayerSpawn when `third_person` > 0.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: PlayerViewpoint. Written by: PlayerSpawn. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init | with `third_person` > 0 on the FPS player: the camera that far behind |
| [PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | distance and height of the camera behind the eyes |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md)**
  - None beyond the context variables.
